paper_title: Advancing Globular Cluster Constraints on the Axion-Photon Coupling
notes: Stellar-evolution (globular cluster R2 parameter) bound: g_agamma < 0.47e-10 GeV^-1 (semiconvection scheme, most conservative). This is a mass-independent bound encoded as a flat line over the mass range shown in the paper's Fig. 1 (1e-8 to 10 eV); physically valid up to axion masses of a few keV where thermal Primakoff production operates. A stronger value of 0.34e-10 GeV^-1 (predictive mixing, supported by asteroseismology) is mentioned but not adopted as the final constraint. Not a dark-matter search, so no local DM density assumption. Limit derived at 95% confidence from observed R2 = 0.117 +/- 0.005. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 2))
